title: 108 Lakes, and No Two Are the Same Color — Sichuan's Jiuzhaigou | China Travel Expert
description:
One valley holds about 108 lakes — and no two of them are the same color. Turquoise, jade, deep blue: all real, no filter.

Jiuzhaigou, in northern Sichuan, is a Y-shaped alpine valley of lakes sitting between 2,000 and 3,400 meters. The colors come from the lake floor: white travertine (calcium hardened out of the limestone rock) lines each pool, the water is so clear you can see 30 meters down, and sunlight plus multi-colored algae paint the rest. It's a UNESCO Natural World Heritage Site (1992) and home to wild giant pandas and Sichuan takin.

🧭 Expert Tip: Take the shuttle bus to the far/high end of the valley first, then walk the boardwalks slowly downhill all day — you'll follow the lakes in the best light and skip the uphill crowds.
